biography: Peter Kox, born in Eindhoven, Netherlands, was practically raised in the paddock. His father, a mechanic for a local touring car team, exposed him to the roar of engines and the scent of burning rubber from a young age. Peter's 'classroom' was the garage, learning the intricacies of race cars while other kids were playing football. His first taste of competitive driving came at 16, tearing up local karting circuits. One defining moment was a daring overtake at the Dutch National Karting Championship in Genk, where he went from fifth to first in the final corner, showcasing the raw aggression that would define his career. Now at 27, Kox is a rising star in the Lamborghini racing program, quickly making a name for himself with his fearless approach and unwavering determination to climb the ranks. He currently participates in GT World Challenge Europe, driving a Lamborghini Huracan GT3 EVO2.
drivingStyle: Kox is known for his aggressive and uncompromising driving style. He attacks every corner with relentless precision, often pushing the limits of the car and tires. His tire management isn't always the best, often prioritizing raw speed over long-run consistency. He thrives under pressure, relishing wheel-to-wheel battles and late-braking duels. Some criticize his over-aggression, but Kox firmly believes in the motto 'go hard or go home'.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during their karting days. The bad blood still simmers whenever they share the track.
Dubois, a seasoned veteran, publicly criticized Kox's driving style as 'reckless'. Kox dismissed her comments, leading to a heated exchange in the media and on the track.
Tanaka and Kox were teammates for a brief period but their differing setup philosophies and driving styles created tension within the team and led to several on-track incidents.

quirks: Always wears the same faded orange t-shirt under his racing suit, a gift from his grandmother.
Listens to Dutch techno music at full volume right before getting into the car to 'get the adrenaline pumping'.
Visits the local 'Friterie' near the circuit for a 'frietje speciaal' before every race weekend.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, not to make friends."
careerHighlight: Winning the GT World Challenge Europe Sprint Cup race at Misano in 2023, after a daring last-lap overtake that secured his first major international victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 24 Hours of Spa in 2022 while leading his class, due to a mechanical failure caused by pushing the car too hard early in the race.
